snippet.title: Monsters are Coming! Xbox Release Date Reveal
snippet.description:
Monsters are Coming! to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox Game Pass on August 6th!

In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Ark?  

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/monsters-are-coming-rock-road/9pjbkf27c16m
